marketScope: US listed common equities and ADRs only

rules.name: Extreme drawdown with continuing volatility
rules.triggerSummary: Price is at least 60% below its 120-session adjusted high; independent fresh prices agree.
rules.warningMeaning: A move of at least 12% in either direction may occur within 30 trading sessions.

rules.name: Trading halt or volatile resumption
rules.triggerSummary: Exchange halt, regulatory halt, limit-up/down event, or trading resumption after material news.
rules.warningMeaning: Price discovery and normal exit assumptions may be unreliable.

rules.name: Delisting or exchange-compliance danger
rules.triggerSummary: Delisting notice, minimum-price deficiency, late filing, or exchange compliance deadline.
rules.warningMeaning: Liquidity, forced selling, and permanent capital-loss risk have increased.

rules.name: Liquidity collapse or abnormal gap risk
rules.triggerSummary: Volume, spread, gap history, or market depth becomes materially worse than normal.
rules.warningMeaning: The user may be unable to enter or exit near the displayed price.

rules.name: Volatility-regime spike
rules.triggerSummary: Realised volatility, intraday range, beta, or option-implied move rises far above its normal range.
rules.warningMeaning: Normal stop-loss, position-size, and expected-move assumptions may be unsafe.

rules.name: Crowded short, squeeze, or positioning risk
rules.triggerSummary: High short interest, expensive borrow, abnormal call activity, or concentrated positioning combines with unusual volume.
rules.warningMeaning: A violent move can occur against either long or short positions.

rules.name: Accounting, auditor, or restatement risk
rules.triggerSummary: Auditor resignation, internal-control weakness, restatement, late filing, or accounting investigation.
rules.warningMeaning: Reported financials or management credibility may be unreliable.

rules.name: Material regulator or law-enforcement action
rules.triggerSummary: SEC, DOJ, FTC, state regulator, court, or other official body files a material case or enforcement action.
rules.warningMeaning: Fines, operating restrictions, management distraction, or discontinuous downside may follow.

rules.name: FDA hold, recall, rejection, or pivotal-trial failure
rules.triggerSummary: Clinical hold, complete-response letter, approval rejection, recall, safety signal, or pivotal failure.
rules.warningMeaning: A major portion of expected product value may disappear quickly.

rules.name: Bankruptcy, going-concern, covenant, or refinancing stress
rules.triggerSummary: Going-concern warning, missed payment, covenant breach, restructuring adviser, Chapter 11 risk, or near-term refinancing gap.
rules.warningMeaning: Equity value may be heavily diluted or permanently impaired.

rules.name: Dilution, ATM, secondary offering, or convertible financing
rules.triggerSummary: New shares, ATM facility, discounted offering, convertible debt, or warrant exercise materially expands supply.
rules.warningMeaning: Per-share value and price support may weaken even when the company raises needed cash.

rules.name: Earnings, guidance, margin, or cash-flow break
rules.triggerSummary: Official results or guidance show a material deterioration beyond normal quarterly noise.
rules.warningMeaning: The investment thesis or valuation assumptions may no longer be valid.

rules.name: Major customer, supplier, or contract loss
rules.triggerSummary: A major contract is lost, a concentrated customer exits, or a critical supplier disruption becomes official.
rules.warningMeaning: Revenue, production, or margins may reset rapidly.

rules.name: Cyberattack, data breach, or operational outage
rules.triggerSummary: Verified cyber incident, ransomware attack, material data breach, or prolonged system outage.
rules.warningMeaning: Operations, remediation costs, legal exposure, and customer trust may be impaired.

rules.name: Sudden leadership or governance break
rules.triggerSummary: Unexpected CEO/CFO departure, board conflict, insider misconduct, or major governance change without a credible transition.
rules.warningMeaning: Execution, reporting, and strategic continuity risk have increased.

rules.name: Merger deal-break or financing failure
rules.triggerSummary: Regulatory rejection, financing failure, shareholder opposition, adverse court ruling, or termination threatens a priced-in transaction.
rules.warningMeaning: The spread can unwind abruptly toward the unaffected price.

rules.name: Geopolitical, tariff, sanction, or supply-chain shock
rules.triggerSummary: A verified policy or conflict event directly affects the issuer's sales, inputs, routes, or licences.
rules.warningMeaning: Earnings exposure can change before the next financial report.

rules.name: Rate, inflation, currency, or commodity sensitivity break
rules.triggerSummary: A large macro move crosses an issuer-specific leverage, duration, input-cost, or currency sensitivity threshold.
rules.warningMeaning: The market may reprice earnings and valuation faster than company reports update.

rules.name: Source contradiction or data-integrity failure
rules.triggerSummary: Independent price, filing, event, or identity sources disagree beyond a defined tolerance.
rules.warningMeaning: No directional alert is safe until the conflict is resolved.

rules.name: Extreme valuation with confirmed momentum reversal
rules.triggerSummary: Valuation is extreme, growth is slowing, and price/volume confirms a persistent reversal rather than a normal pullback.
rules.warningMeaning: Multiple compression may amplify fundamental disappointment.
